// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// The register tile on /ops/health, in the shape it actually ships in: a count
// and the last run of the import job. A count returns a number, not a row, so
// no projection question arises and no column is named — which is also why the
// denylist entry on `postcode` costs this screen nothing.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { requireOperator } from "@/lib/ops/session";

export async function readRegister() {
  await requireOperator();
  const total = await db.establishment.count();
  const run = await db.jobRun.findFirst({
    where: { job: "gias:import" },
    orderBy: [{ startedAt: "desc" }],
    select: { startedAt: true, outcome: true, itemsAffected: true, outcomeDetail: true },
  });
  return { total, run };
}
